hotels.title: Coastal Geelong One- & Two-Bedroom Apartments near Eastern Beach with Complimentary Parking
hotels.description: Set on Bellerine Street in a restored heritage-listed building, Oaks R Suites Geelong puts you within easy walking distance of both Eastern Beach and the sparkling waterfront. Each modern apartment comes with all the comforts of home, with a fully equipped kitchen, cosy lounge area, private balcony to savour views of the sea or lush parklands, plus an in-room washer and dryer, which is especially handy if you’re staying a few nights or heading out to Adventure Park. Le Cafe has all your daily breakfast and coffee needs sorted, while onsite parking, including an electric charging station, makes taking daytrips easier than ever. When you want to explore, this is a well-connected spot for making the most of the bay and the city with Eastern Beach is just a two-minute walk away, while both the CBD and Geelong Botanic Gardens are just a four-minute drive away.
